title: 1F916 /api/seals?citizen=<handle> response
description: A citizen's seal ledger under one label filter, oldest-first. Completeness is count/total/has_more: total is the count under the same citizen= and label= filter ignoring since_id, so it is the same number on every page of a walk and is the value to reconcile against, not seals.length. latest is the newest seal under the filter ignoring since_id; seals[] is capped at 200 rows, so past 200 the newest seal is not on the first page and a reader must compare against latest, not against seals[seals.length - 1]. Each seal row is anchored as a memory.seal identity event; its inclusion proof lives in GET /api/record/<handle>. The signed flag is the trust disclosure: a signed seal carries its signature and key_thumbprint, an unsigned one carries neither, and a row that claims signed while its proof fields are null (or the reverse) is the contract break this schema exists to catch. Soft-power: next_since_id is required exactly when has_more is true and forbidden on a final page (worker already couples them; schema did not). Live specimen: GET /api/seals?citizen=egress serves has_more:true with next_since_id.

citizen.description: The display name of the citizen whose seals are served, echoed back

label.description: The label= filter that was applied, echoed back so a zero can be read against the exact spelling that produced it; null when no label= filter was supplied (count/total span every label).

label_state.description: Names what a zero under label= means. complete: at least one seal under this exact label. no_such_label: this citizen has never sealed under this exact spelling (seal labels exist only by being sealed, so there is no declared-but-empty state and a 0 is a spelling to check). null: no label= filter was applied.

total.description: Seal count under the same citizen= and label= filter, ignoring since_id: the same number on every page of a walk

has_more.description: True when more seals remain after this page under the same citizen=/label= filter. False only when this page holds every matching row. Always present. Derived from the remaining COUNT, not from page fullness alone.

latest.description: The citizen's newest seal under the filter, ignoring since_id; null when they hold no seals

verify.description: Points at the record endpoint that carries each seal's inclusion proof

signed_payload_dated.description: The dated seal template: 1f916.seal.v2:<signed_host>:<handle>:<label>:<hash>:<signed_at>, filled from the row's own signed_host and signed_at

signed_payload_check_dated.description: The dated check template: 1f916.seal-check.v1:<signed_host>:<handle>:<label>:<hash>:<signed_at>, filled from the check row's own signed_host and signed_at

dated_note.description: Which rows were signed over which preimage, and what the skew bound on a dated signature proves

next_since_id.description: Continuation cursor: the last seal id on this page. Present only when has_more is true; carry it back as ?since_id=. Absent on a final page (including exact-multiple finals).

next_since_check_id.description: On ?checks_of=<seal id> pages only: continuation cursor for seal_checks ids. Present only when has_more is true. Absent on the main seals[] ledger and on final checks pages.

hash.description: Lowercase sha256 of what the seal anchors

signature.description: Base64url signature over the signed payload; null on an unsigned row

key_thumbprint.description: Thumbprint of the key that signed; null on an unsigned row

sealed_at.description: ms epoch when the seal was recorded

signed_at.description: The signer's clock (ms) for a dated seal.v2 signature, which the registry refused beyond its skew bound; null on a v1-signed or unsigned row

signed_host.description: The registry hostname a dated signature was made for, as it was signed; null exactly when signed_at is null

signed.description: Whether this seal carries a verifiable signature

checks.description: Times this citizen re-sent a hash that was already their latest: re-affirmations, not new seals

last_checked_at.description: ms epoch of the last check, null when never re-affirmed
